_about: Bibliography for the site FabCon Europe 2026: AI, security and governance. Session sources are cited by speaker where the speaker is known, otherwise by session title. Web sources were found on 2026-10-04 and must be re-checked before publication. Slide content is paraphrased or quoted briefly; no slide images are published.
